**Finding: compliant** (rule IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data).

The IP provisions sit at the preferred position and run in our favour:
- **§13.1 (p0197)**: MSL assigns, and IBM owns, all IP rights in hardware, software, design and documentation of all Products delivered.
- **p0198**: IBM owns MSL inventions on Products and on IBM processes/systems; the only carve-out is MSL's right to use those inventions in performing its obligations to us — a benign operational licence back.
- **§13.3(a) (p0208)**: no rights or licences in IBM pre-existing IP pass to MSL, other than a royalty-free right to use IBM confidential information solely to manufacture Products for IBM; anything further needs a separate signed IBM agreement.
- **§13.2 / AECI**: IBM information stays confidential with return on request; **Loan Agreement §5 (p1530)**: IBM retains title to all Loaned Items.

No assignment of IBM IP or data to MSL, no vendor-owned deliverables, and no joint ownership anywhere in the document. No redline proposed.
